senses.sense_definition: Relating to the duties, rights, and responsibilities of a citizen within a community.

examples.text: Voting in elections is considered a fundamental <w>civic</w> duty in a democracy.

target_lang_translations.tr: Seçimlerde oy kullanmak, bir demokraside temel bir <w>vatandaşlık</w> görevi olarak kabul edilir.
